answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 8411 Country: United States of America Title: Is a man allowed to shave his mostache as it comes in hadith that one should grow ones beard and cut his mostache so does shaving go under cutting? explain please. Question: Is a man allowed to shave his mostache as it comes in hadith that one should grow ones beard and cut his mostache so does shaving go under cutting? explain please. Answer ID: 8411 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1376/224/=L/1429) It is permitted to shave moustache, the word (jazzu) mentioned in Hadith mean: cutting off, while the other word (uHfu) in Hadith means: trimming moustache closer to shaving. Therefore, it is better to trim down moustache closer to shaving. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
